WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.category, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS control
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND r.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1
),
dups AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dup_lines, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.fiscal_year, m.mine, c.control, m.mine - c.control AS gap, x.dup_lines, x.n
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year) JOIN dups x USING (fiscal_year)

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS category_then, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_cat AS (
    SELECT cp.category, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN n.category_then <> cp.category THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS moved_in_or_out
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.category, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct,
       ly.moved_in_or_out AS ly_restated_amount, ty.moved_in_or_out AS ty_restated_amount
FROM by_cat ty JOIN by_cat ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY 1
